name: APIVerveImageCaption
summary: Image Caption generates natural language descriptions for uploaded image files.
description:
Image Caption generates natural language descriptions for uploaded image files. Upload a JPG, PNG, or GIF up to 5MB to receive an automated caption for alt text and media tagging.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Image Caption from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
